# RWTAM golden wave7 fixture

Wave7 is the audit-round-6 BNPL scenario-only refreeze. The default opening
balance sheet carries no BNPL positions; the BNPL channel remains as an explicit
amortized scenario exhibit.

The combined-sinks correction was not promoted in this fixture because the
round-5 spec uses different exported stock deltas for year-1 and cumulative
horizons.
